fact: The DHIS2 for Education implementation page states that the ministry's Basic Education Department has been piloting DHIS2-DEMIS, a district-level EMIS, since 2019 in two provinces, as an aggregate integration with StatEduc, with the Ministry of Education, GPE KIX and Saudigitus as funders and partners; it describes district officers capturing data, not schools, and no per-learner record.
title: Mozambique - DHIS2
